About Us

Our History and Values

The company Weld Tech Group has been constantly expanding its range of services and improving the quality of work in the field of welding and installation of technological pipelines, production of metal structures and industrial containers since its establishment. International experience gained in various industries: food, chemical, energy.
Obtaining certificates ISO 3834 – 2,1090-1034 and engineering staff allows for developing documentation and managing projects, ensuring work execution guarantee.
Our reliability and professionalism are confirmed by long-term relationships with regular clients in Poland, Lithuania, Germany and other European countries.

Five immutable principles that form the basis of our work.

1

Quality proven by time

We apply modern welding methods, using only certified materials. Each production stage is strictly controlled, which guarantees durability and safety of finished structures.

2

Teamwork

Our specialists have a high level of preparation and regularly improve their qualifications. They can work with a wide range of materials: from high-alloy and low-alloy steels to titanium and aluminum. Such a professional approach allows us to flawlessly implement both standard and non-standard projects.

3

Customer orientation

We listen to customer needs and strive to propose an optimal solution taking into account budget, deadlines and specifics of a particular enterprise. Individual approach and flexibility in work help build long-term partnership relations.

4

Responsibility and transparency

Compliance with technical standards, environmental requirements and safety standards — unconditional priority. We document and certify each stage of work, ensuring maximum complete reporting to clients and controlling bodies.

5

Continuous improvement

We invest in modern equipment, innovative technologies and employee training. This ensures a high level of competence and allows us to maintain a leading position in the welding and installation services market.

Thanks to such a comprehensive approach, Weld Tech Group enjoys well-deserved trust from both large industrial enterprises and small companies looking for a reliable contractor. Our main goal is to transform customer ideas into efficient, safe and durable solutions that are an example of quality and professionalism.

Our Services

Over

50

highly qualified workers with years of experience in welding composite materials and other materials with complex weldability properties.

Our team — are highly qualified welders and constructors who regularly undergo training and master modern technologies, document and certify each stage of work. A key role in the company is played by welders who can perform "mirror welding", as well as welding pipes from stainless steel, various alloys and structures. They flawlessly handle work on materials from carbon and alloy steel (including carbides) to difficult-to-weld metals, ensuring high quality of connections and assembly.
